summary: Lumexa Imaging Holdings filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing credit agreement. The amendment provides a $823 million secured term loan (SOFR+2.50%) maturing December 2032 and a $250 million secured revolver (SOFR+2.50%) maturing December 2030. The credit agreement contains restrictive covenants including a net leverage ratio covenant triggered when revolver usage exceeds 40%. The facility is guaranteed by substantially all wholly-owned subsidiaries and secured by their assets. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation.
